# QCrypton PQC Proxy Posture

Post-quantum TLS proxy telemetry from `PQCProxy_CL`. Monitors PQC handshake adoption, certificate health, TLS errors, upstream connectivity, and downgrade attempts across PQC Proxy instances.

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "handshake"
| summarize Count = count() by QuantumPosture
| render piechart
content.title: PQC vs classical handshake posture

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "handshake"
| summarize PQC = countif(QuantumPosture == "pqc-hybrid"), Classical = countif(QuantumPosture == "classical") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: PQC vs classical handshakes over time

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "handshake"
| summarize Requests = count(), AvgLatencyMs = round(avg(RequestLatencyMs), 1), P95LatencyMs = round(percentile(RequestLatencyMs, 95), 1) by ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Proxy instance overview

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "handshake"
| summarize Count = count() by NegotiatedGroup
| order by Count desc
| render barchart
content.title: Negotiated key-exchange groups

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "downgrade"
| project TimeGenerated, ProxyHost, ClientIP, NegotiatedGroup, OfferedGroups, CipherSuite
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: PQC downgrade events

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "cert_expiry"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProxyInstanceId, CertPath
| project ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId, CertPath, CertExpiryDays = round(CertExpiryDays, 0), LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| order by CertExpiryDays asc
content.title: Certificate expiry status

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "tls_error"
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), DistinctClients = dcount(ClientIP), Errors = make_set(ErrorMessage, 5) by ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId
| order by ErrorCount desc
content.title: TLS handshake failures by proxy

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == "upstream_error"
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), Errors = make_set(ErrorMessage, 5) by ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId, UpstreamTarget
| order by ErrorCount desc
content.title: Upstream connection failures
